findings.issue: AC-06 spec says 'p-treasury-exec содержит 3 атома' but implementation has 4 atoms (ledger.recon:read and ledger.recon:update are separate atoms). Test comment on line 129 says '4 atoms' — code is correct, spec is imprecise. No toHaveLength(4) assertion exists in AC-06 test.
findings.suggestion: Fix spec AC-06 to say '4 atoms'; add expect(preset!.grants).toHaveLength(4) in grant-presets.test.ts AC-06 describe block.

findings.issue: axesFromGrants checks g.ops.includes('exec') for external axis, but new presets use ops: ['invoke']. axesFromGrants will not raise external:true for p-treasury-exec and p-pay-init-limited. UI criticality display via critLevel(axesFromGrants(...)) underestimates external axis. Hardcoded critical:true in presets preserves the UI warning badge. Runtime T-0044 gate is unaffected. Pre-existing pattern from legacy TRAIL entries. Not a T-0135 regression.
findings.suggestion: In a separate nit-sweep task: update axesFromGrants to check ops.includes('invoke') || ops.includes('exec') for external and guarded axes.

role_gap_evidence: axesFromGrants legacy op-vocab gap (exec vs invoke) affects UI criticality display but not runtime gate; candidate for nit-sweep or dedicated task under T-0030 domain
